decisions.reason: The air cooled condenser was promoted to a page of its own in 2024, which signals that its option value is being realized, and keeping a product so close to the core offer costs little.
Like B, it gained a dedicated page in 2024, which shows rising commitment, and its closeness to the established offer keeps carrying costs low.
The tube liner fits the firm's growing lifecycle service business and costs little to keep listed, so its still-uncertain value justifies holding the option for now.
Customized air coolers are built to order and are cheap to keep on offer, although the firm's many overlapping air cooler options raise the risk of consolidation, as happened with Product A.
Tube end repair inserts support the service and spare parts business at minimal carrying cost, so the option is worth keeping while demand becomes clearer.
